description: Use of Upper Deck, Unit 6, Phoenix Wharf as a self-contained residential unit (Class C3).Upper Deck Unit 6 has two floors (first and mezzanine) and this unit been in continuous use as a self-contained residential flat (Class C3) since 13 October 2022, a period now exceeding four years.
